# Hill climb: minimize (energy_of_target - mfe_energy) i.e. make target the MFE
def score(s):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(s)
    m,e=fc.mfe()
    et=fc.eval_structure(t)
    # we want et <= e (target lower). gap = et - e (positive bad)
    d=RNA.bp_distance(m,t)
    gap=et-e
    return d, gap, m

deadline=time.time()+120
